cost_comment: MEASURED 2026-08-16 with ignoreStatic on: 59 minutes wall clock (20:54-21:53), exit 0, mutation
score 77.18 (868 killed / 240 survived / 17 no-coverage / 21 errors / 1 timeout over 1147
mutants, 33.46 tests per mutant on average). Weakest files: use-editor-preferences.ts 70.10 and
use-asciidoc-preview.ts 76.16; use-key-bindings.ts is at 100.
WHY ignoreStatic IS ON. Without it this run reports an ETA of 10-14 HOURS, and the cause is not
'React suites are slow' — Stryker names it itself on every run:
'Detected 42 static mutants (4% of total) that are estimated to take 91% of the time'.
A STATIC mutant sits in code that executes at module-load time rather than inside a test, so
perTest coverage cannot narrow it down and Stryker must re-run the ENTIRE 2713-test suite for
each one. 42 mutants x the whole suite is the entire cost; the other ~1147 are cheap.
Do NOT try to extrapolate this run's duration from an early throughput sample. Early mutants are
the cheap non-static ones, so a linear extrapolation understates the total by roughly an order of
magnitude. That mistake was made once already.
WHAT THIS COSTS US, stated plainly rather than left implicit: the 42 static mutants are NOT
tested by this run. They are excluded, not killed, and they do not appear as survivors in the
report. To cover them, run once with ignoreStatic false and budget many hours.
enableFindRelatedTests: TRUE is the other obvious fix and DOES NOT WORK here — it was tried and
produced 27 ChildProcessCrashedError failures (jest's --findRelatedTests does not survive this
custom-config setup). Do not re-apply it without re-testing.
Mutation testing is deliberately NOT part of gate.sh or CI. It is a quality instrument run by
hand when hardening a module, not a required check.
